name: Coaster set
blurb: Four square coasters to keep drinks off the table — a great first gift.

steps.text: Measure 3-1/2 inches from the end of the 1x4 and mark it.
Draw a square line across at the mark.
Cut it in the miter box, then measure, mark and cut the next one. One at a time, because each cut takes a little wood with it.
Sand every face and round the sharp edges a little.
Wipe on a water-based clear finish and let it dry.
